nodes.title: PDD 8-Step Setup · Ref2VA（必须匹配完整基模）

widgets_values:
Use the reference video as the absolute source of truth for motion, shot design, timing, pacing, speaking order, and dialogue timing.

This is a strict character-replacement task, not a new scene invention task.

Highest priority:
1. Preserve the exact shot progression and character motion rhythm from the reference video.
2. Preserve the exact Chinese dialogue content and speaking timing.
3. Replace only the character identities and visual appearance.
4. Keep the same emotional structure, performance rhythm, and scene logic.

Replace the original characters in the reference video with these two new characters:

Character A:
a young Asian woman with medium-long brown hair, sweet natural facial features, a slim and proportionate body, wearing a nude-beige seamless bra and matching nude-beige seamless panties, barefoot, soft and natural appearance.

Character B:
a tall muscular blond man with Western facial structure, short blond hair, calm and stern expression, wearing a dark blue superhero-style skin-tight combat suit, red gloves, red boots, gold decorative details on the shoulders and waist, and a red-white-blue cape with American-flag elements. He should look powerful, upright, restrained, and imposing.

General scene requirement:
Preserve the same scene structure and mood as the reference video: an intimate, dramatic, warm-toned ancient-style interior with dark red drapery, blue crystal bead curtains, warm candlelight, shallow depth of field, and soft glowing bokeh in the background. The atmosphere is flirtatious, tense, and emotionally charged. Character A is teasing and seductive. Character B is restrained, silent, and self-controlled.

Do not change the order of shots.
Do not change the line timing.
Do not change who speaks.
Do not add new dialogue.
Do not remove dialogue.
Do not add new actions that are not present in the reference.
Do not turn it into action, comedy, dancing, hugging, fighting, or exaggerated performance.
Keep the motion subtle and faithful to the reference.

Character speaking rule:
All spoken dialogue in the clip belongs to Character A.
Character B remains silent throughout this 14-second clip.

Chinese dialogue lock:
Use the exact spoken Chinese dialogue below, with the same emotional intent and the same approximate timing as the reference video:
- “你说四大皆空”
- “却紧闭双眼”
- “要是你睁开眼睛看看我”
- “我不相信你两眼空空”

Subtitle requirement:
If subtitles are rendered, display simplified Chinese hard subtitles matching the spoken dialogue exactly, appearing only during the corresponding spoken intervals, centered near the bottom of the frame, clean readable style, white text with a subtle dark outline. No extra subtitles during silent intervals.

Video length:
14 seconds total.
30 fps.
Maintain the same pacing and editing rhythm as the reference video.

Detailed timeline:

0.0s–0.9s
Opening transition shot.
Show a close-up side-profile shot of Character A.
The camera looks at her through a layer of blue crystal bead curtains.
Behind her is a dark red draped background with small warm glowing bokeh lights.
Character A is calm, slightly smiling, and silent.
No dialogue.
No subtitle.
This is a quiet introductory mood shot.
Keep the framing intimate and elegant.

1.0s–2.4s
Stay on the same side-profile close-up of Character A behind the bead curtain.
She opens her mouth and begins speaking with a teasing, lightly playful tone.
Dialogue spoken by Character A in Chinese:
“你说四大皆空”
Her expression is amused and gently provocative.
Her motion is subtle: a small mouth movement, delicate facial expression change, very slight head-angle and eye movement.
Keep the shot composition unchanged.
Show the corresponding Chinese subtitle only during this line.

2.5s–3.9s
Continue the same uninterrupted side-profile close-up shot.
Character A keeps speaking, now with a slightly more coquettish and softly reproachful tone.
Dialogue spoken by Character A in Chinese:
“却紧闭双眼”
She gives a slightly more intimate, knowing expression.
Her smile becomes a little more pointed, with a hint of playful accusation.
No camera cut.
No major body movement.
Keep the same bead-curtain framing and side-profile composition.
Show the corresponding Chinese subtitle only during this line.

4.0s–6.9s
Silent reaction interval.
No dialogue.
No subtitle.
Still keep the same side-profile close-up of Character A.
She lowers her gaze slightly, keeps a faint smile, and lets her expression breathe.
This is a subtle emotional transition.
Her eyes shift gently, and her expression becomes softer and more observant.
The shot remains restrained and elegant.
No major action.
No new camera angle yet.

7.0s–9.4s
The shot changes to a frontal close-up of Character A.
She now faces more toward the camera.
Her smile deepens and becomes more direct, more confident, and more openly seductive.
Dialogue spoken by Character A in Chinese:
“要是你睁开眼睛看看我”
Her delivery should feel more forward and intentional than the earlier lines.
Keep the shot steady.
Her face is clearly visible.
Her mouth movement must sync tightly to the Chinese line.
Her expression should be warm, alluring, and direct.
Show the corresponding Chinese subtitle only during this line.

9.5s–14.0s
The video changes to a two-person composition.
Character B now appears on the left side of the frame.
Character A is on the right side, leaning in close toward Character B.
Between them is a candle flame or candlelight source that flickers warmly, preserving the intimate dramatic tone of the original shot.
Character B should remain restrained and silent, maintaining the emotional role of someone resisting temptation or controlling himself.
He should not speak.
He should appear composed, tense, and inwardly controlled.
Character A continues speaking while leaning close to him.

Dialogue spoken by Character A in Chinese:
“我不相信你两眼空空”

This line should carry conviction and emotional insistence.
Her tone is firm, intimate, and challenging, as if she does not believe he is truly detached.
The two-shot remains until the end of the clip.
The candlelight flickers subtly.
Character A remains close to Character B, maintaining the same spatial intimacy and tension as the reference.
Character B stays mostly still, silent, and self-restrained.
Show the corresponding Chinese subtitle only during this spoken line.
End the clip naturally during this line, with the same abrupt unfinished feeling as the reference.

Performance notes:
Character A carries the entire spoken performance.
Her emotional progression should follow this arc:
- playful teasing
- flirtatious reproach
- silent observation
- direct temptation
- confident insistence

Character B carries the silent counter-performance:
- restraint
- silence
- composure
- emotional suppression
- visible self-control

Motion constraints:
Preserve the original motion style from the reference:
- subtle head turns
- slight eye movement
- restrained facial acting
- minimal upper-body motion
- no exaggerated gestures
- no additional movement inventions
- no changed blocking

Visual style:
realistic live-action
cinematic
warm interior lighting
shallow depth of field
soft glowing highlights
dramatic but intimate
emotionally tense
natural skin texture
stable character identity
no cartoon style
no anime style
no game CG look
no extra limbs
no face drift
no costume change

Negative constraints:
Do not change the dialogue text.
Do not translate the dialogue into another language.
Do not let Character B speak.
Do not add extra lines.
Do not remove pauses.
Do not alter shot order.
Do not invent new camera moves.
Do not add comedy.
Do not add fighting.
Do not add hugging or kissing.
Do not add any extra people.
Do not replace the candlelit dramatic mood with a different setting style.

Final output goal:
A 14-second video that faithfully preserves the reference clip’s shot progression, timing, emotional rhythm, and exact Chinese dialogue, while replacing the original two characters with:
- the beige-underwear young woman as Character A
- the blond superhero man as Character B
